curatedMovie.curiosityHook: A daring prison escape unites a warrior and a rebel, but as their journey begins, neither their true allegiances nor their motives are what they seem.
curatedMovie.description: In 9th-century China, as a corrupt government clashes with the rebel Flying Daggers, a warrior breaks an imprisoned rebel free to guide her back to her comrades, sparking a perilous journey fraught with hidden motives.
curatedMovie.vibeSummary: Exciting, suspenseful, and emotionally charged, offering an agile pace and engaged drama fit for a captivating date night.
curatedMovie.whyWatch: This action-adventure drama brings a prison escape and uncertain allegiances into a sweeping historical conflict.
